title: Hardcore Tatoo
description: This mod gives you a Tatoo on your Arm that shows you, your Health and Hunger
body:
This mod gives you a Tatoo on your Arm that shows you, your Health, Hunger, (Armor and Effects): only for version 2.0.0!![The Tatoo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14e1f90a8ab6165ed5811444c4d0d162f1566724.png)
The mod was build for playing without minecrafts HUD
